snippet.title: Bound City Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The night doesn’t end. The tower rises up. Everyone feels its pull. The song echoes through the city. There are those who make pilgrimage to the base of the tower to be subsumed. There are those who go mad from fear or anticipation and attack all around them. There are those who merely struggle to survive and to retain their sense of self.

But Rain is the hero, awoken at last, to defeat evil and kill the endless night.
